system.description:
You spin your flail and strike out as it wraps around your enemy’s ligament and you pull attempting to crush their bones. Make a melee taijutsu attack. On a hit, the target creature is Grappled by you. You can choose to force the affected creature to make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, they take your [Weapons damage] +2d4 and they become Bruised.

Chain 1: Affected creature that fails their saving throw has their arm heavily damaged as they are disarmed of any weapons or items they are holding. They cannot hold items or weapons until the end of their next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of creatures you can target by +1. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, creatures who fail their saving throw is also knocked Prone. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, affected creatures cannot cast jutsu with the Hand Sign (HS) component.
